structure: CSharp signature inference follows structural product labels before registry interning. Native product inference waits for a complete product value. Stable function/type projection borrows one SemanticTypeSet containing corresponding nodes, references and fields; the obsolete split-node view API was removed.
branches: CSharp inferred product field reads use the shared nested-type delimiter parser and the same explicit/positional field naming as GetOrAddProduct, without allocating types during inference.
Native product-element inference excludes operands behind a nested product boundary.
Native omitted-return inference likewise excludes product operands until the product itself is typed, preventing premature call/parameter facts.
Ordinary and specialized stable function identities use the common field plan and the complete resolved type graph.

A separate explicit call-input-types probe mode compares actual generic call argument structures. It does not admit a function identity or cache entry when numeric specialization registration is still missing.
logic: Preserve field ordering, labels, unlabelled positional fields, nested field types, CSharp function names, type registration identities, expected output, existing timeouts and full goal scope.
diagnostics: Reproduced CSharp cannot-infer failure and native full-identity mismatches were fixed and retained. Unregistered body-composite specialization names still reject metadata with exit 6; that remains an open implementation requirement.
